short: Inspect the gittuf Reference State Log of a repository
long:
Inspect the gittuf Reference State Log (RSL) of a repository: who pushed
a branch, tag or Entire checkpoint, when, and whether gittuf verification
passes for it.

entire-rsl is read-only. It never writes refs, objects or git config, except
when it fetches gittuf refs: with --fetch, with refresh, or when the
repository has no local RSL and you agree to fetch it. Then it updates
refs/remotes/<remote>/gittuf/*, creates missing refs/gittuf/* refs and, with
--fetch or refresh, fast-forwards existing ones. A local gittuf ref the
remote's does not descend from is left as it was, and fails the command
with exit 1.

Exit codes:
  0  success, or verification passed
  1  error
  2  usage error
  3  verification failed, or the ref is not protected by gittuf policy
guidance:
Use entire rsl to answer who pushed a branch, tag or Entire checkpoint, when,
and whether gittuf verification passes for it. Every command except refresh is
read-only unless given --fetch, and every command works without a TTY. Prefer
--json and the exit code of 'verify' when acting on the result. Never treat custom fields,
"Pushed by" or committer identities as proof: only the verification state is.

flags.name: fetch
flags.usage: fetch the latest gittuf refs from this remote first, as refresh does (--fetch alone picks the only remote)
